content: Nonpharmacologic strategies are strongly encouraged and include increasing dietary salt intake, utilizing compression garments such as stockings or abdominal binders, and engaging in regular physical activity to improve vascular tone and circulation. In cases where nonpharmacologic interventions prove insufficient, pharmacologic treatments may be considered. Medications such as midodrine, an alpha-adrenergic agonist, and droxidopa, a norepinephrine precursor, can be prescribed to help mitigate symptoms.
